SELECT


    s.STATUS_ID,
    s.STATUS_NAME,
    /* ============================================================
       REQUEST
       ============================================================ */
			 r.request_comment,
    r.REQUEST_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(r.REQUEST_ID) AS REQUEST_ID_HEX,
m.company_name_Ar,m.CONTRACT_MDR_VALUE,
    r.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
    r.CONTRACT_PDF_REF,
    r.BANK_SHEET_REF,
    r.RECEIVED_AT,
    r.REQUEST_DATE,
    r.PREVIOUS_REQUEST_DATE,
		r.status_id,

    /* ============================================================
       STATUS
       ============================================================ */
    r.STATUS_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(r.STATUS_ID) AS STATUS_ID_HEX,

    s.STATUS_CODE,
    s.STATUS_NAME,
    s.FLOW_STATUS_STEP_NO,

    /* Keep temporarily for migration/backward compatibility */
    r.CURRENT_STAGE,

    /* ============================================================
       MAKER
       ============================================================ */
    r.MAKER_ID,
    r.MAKER_ACTION,
    r.MAKER_AT,

    /* ============================================================
       FRAUD
       ============================================================ */
    r.FRAUD_ID,
    r.FRAUD_ACTION,
    r.FRAUD_AT,

    /* ============================================================
       CHECKER
       ============================================================ */
    r.CHECKER_ID,
    r.CHECKER_ACTION,
    r.CHECKER_AT,

    /* ============================================================
       REJECTION / PUSHBACK
       ============================================================ */
    r.REJECT_REASON_CODE,
    r.REJECT_REASON_DESC,
    r.BANK_PUSHBACK_NOTE,

    /* ============================================================
       AUDIT
       ============================================================ */
    r.CREATED_AT,
    r.UPDATED_AT,
    r.CREATED_BY,
    r.UPDATED_BY,

    /* ============================================================
       MERCHANT
       ============================================================ */
    m.MERCHANT_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(m.MERCHANT_ID) AS MERCHANT_ID_HEX,

    m.CIF,
    m.NATIONAL_ID,
    m.OWNER_NAME_AR,
    m.COMPANY_NAME,
    m.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
    m.MERCHANT_NAME_AR,

    /* ============================================================
       CONTACT
       ============================================================ */
    m.CONTACT_NAME_AR,
    m.MOBILE_PRIMARY,
    m.ADDRESS_EN,
    m.ADDRESS_AR,

    /* ============================================================
       LOCATION
       ============================================================ */
    m.CITY,
    m.REGION,
    m.BRANCH_CODE,
    m.TEAM_LEADER,
    m.RM_ORACLE_CODE,

    /* ============================================================
       COMMERCIAL
       ============================================================ */
    m.BANK_ACCOUNT,

    m.MCC_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(m.MCC_ID) AS MCC_ID_HEX,

    m.PACKAGE_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(m.PACKAGE_ID) AS PACKAGE_ID_HEX,

    m.CONTRACT_MDR,
    m.OTHER_POS_COMMISSION,
		s.STATUS_CODE

FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST r

left JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_STATUS s
        ON s.STATUS_ID = r.STATUS_ID

 JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT m
       ON m.MERCHANT_ID = r.MERCHANT_ID
      AND m.IS_DELETED = 0

WHERE r.REQUEST_ID =
      HEXTORAW(
          REPLACE(
              '{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.requestId }}',
              '-',
              ''
          )
      )
  AND r.IS_DELETED = 0
